name: You are given the following quantum programming task. Perform single-qubit state
task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Perform single-qubit state tomography in Qiskit by hand: prepare RY(1.943) RZ(3.868)|0>, measure X, Y, Z expectation values with StatevectorEstimator, reconstruct the density matrix rho = (I + <X>X + <Y>Y + <Z>Z)/2, and report fidelity with the true state. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
